M/S My Nutrition Pvt Ltd vs Food Safety & Standards Authority 
Of ... on 3 May, 2024 
Author: Sudhir Kumar Jain
Bench: Sudhir Kumar Jain
 $~3
 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
 + W.P.(C) 8378/2016, Cm Appl. 34672/2016, 
 & Cm Appl. 1969/2017
 M/S My Nutrition Pvt Ltd 
 Th
 
 versus
 Food Safety & Standards Authority 
 Of India And Ors ..... 
 Th
 
 
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Sudhir Kumar Jain
 Order
% 03.05.2024 1. The counsel for the respondent no. 3/Commissioner of Customs, on instructions from the concerned department, stated that the respondent no. 3 has not raised any demand against the petitioner. 
2. Accordingly, the counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to withdraw the present petition but with liberty that in case any demand is raised by the respondent no. 3/Commissioner of Customs in future, then the petitioner reserves his right to initiate appropriate legal proceedings.
3. Liberty as prayed for is granted. 
4. The present petition stands dismissed as withdrawn. 
DR. SUDHIR KUMAR JAIN, J MAY 3, 2024/ sk/hvk This is a digitally signed order.
